cs.t: I use a GPD Win Max 2 for this purpose ( https://fluctlight.net/gpd_win_max_2 ) and while it has its quirks, the performance of a Ryzen APU is significantly better than the Chuwi Minibook X. I think my desire for this kind of product is something lighter, but this set of notes on the Chuwi feels like the compromises GPD gives you but with less power.
cs.th: Chuwi Minibook X: the netbook we deserve
